hero.title:
Same rigour.
Different bench.
hero.lede: Three years reading clinical assays, then a change of direction. A dozen shipped projects later the method hasn't changed: define the sample, run the method, read the result.

plate.empty: Select a well to read the sample.

skills.title: How the lab shows up in the code
skills.lede: Three years running RIA and EIA assays before I wrote production code. Lab work is engineering with worse consequences — a mislabelled tube is somebody's diagnosis. Six habits came with me.
